clues.text: After the flood, God set His rainbow in the clouds as the sign of this between Him and the earth.
God told Abraham that circumcising the flesh of the foreskin would be the sign of this between them.
Jonathan made one of these with David because he loved him as himself.
After supper with His disciples, Jesus took the cup and called it the new one of these in His blood.
On the mountain with God for forty days, Moses wrote the Ten Commandments on tablets as the words of this.
Standing by the pillar in the temple, King Josiah made this before the LORD, and all the people entered into it.
Through Jeremiah, God promised one where He would write His law on the hearts of His people.
